topic: Week 1 recap: 6 Claude lessons for beginners in 60 seconds
post:
One week of learning Claude, no tech background needed. 🎓
Here's everything we covered, in 60 seconds.

1️⃣ Chat, Cowork or Claude Code?
Chat answers questions. Cowork handles whole tasks. Claude Code builds software.

2️⃣ Hallucinations
AI can sound sure and still be wrong. Let it say "I don't know," ask for quotes, and check numbers.

3️⃣ Your first Claude Code project
Describe a tiny tool in plain English, use a new folder, review before approving.

4️⃣ The "new employee" prompt
Give Claude the goal, the context and the format, like briefing a new teammate.

5️⃣ Put tasks on autopilot
Type /schedule in Cowork to run a task daily or weekly.

6️⃣ Stay safe
One working folder. Keep secrets out. Trusted sites only. Watch what it does.

Why it matters:
None of this needs coding. It needs clear instructions and good habits. That's a skill anyone can build.

Your challenge for next week: pick ONE lesson and actually try it on real work.

Which lesson are you trying first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
